name: Floating islands
desc: a broken land hanging in open air, crossed by bridges, where a fall has no bottom
tags: floating islands in open sky, exposed rock undersides, roots and vines hanging beneath, waterfall spilling off the edge into open air, rope and stone bridges between islands, smaller islands in the distance, clouds passing between them
prose: a chain of islands hanging in open sky, their broken rock undersides trailing roots and vines, a waterfall pouring off one edge into empty air, rope and stone bridges strung between them and smaller islands receding into the haze
note: The failure is islands sitting on an invisible ground plane, i.e. ordinary hills. What sells the float is the UNDERSIDE - exposed rock and hanging roots - plus water falling off an edge into nothing and visible sky underneath. Always keep one island small and distant so the eye gets depth; a single island alone reads as a cliff.
